doc.title: Customer Complaints and Lot Trace
doc.file: QP-316 Customer Complaints and Lot Trace.pdf
doc.purpose: Answer every customer complaint and find all product from the same lot.

roles.name: Quality Manager
roles.does: Owns each complaint until it is closed.

roles.name: Shift Lead
roles.does: Supplies the production and downtime records for the shift.

parameters.what: time to open the complaint record
parameters.quote: Open FRM-QA-20 Complaint Record within one working day.
Reply to the customer within 5 working days with the cause and the action taken.

parameters.what: time to hand shift records to QA Technician
parameters.quote: Give the QA Technician the shift's records and any notes within one working day.

rules.statement: The QA Technician places any remaining stock from the same lot on hold.
rules.quote: Place any remaining stock from the same lot on hold as described in QP-315.

rules.topic: who supplies shift records for a lot trace
rules.statement: The Shift Lead gives the QA Technician the shift's records.
rules.quote: Shift Lead: Give the QA Technician the shift's records and any notes within one working day.
